newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Living to buy NY residences.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Living to buy NY residences.

text.p: Alternative Living Services Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire interests in three recently constructed assisted living residences in upstate New York with a total capacity of 313 residents.

Alternative Living will purchase all of one residence which has reached stabilized occupancy and will acquire a majority interest, with purchase options for the remaining minority interests, in each of the other two.
Alternative Living said the acquisitions represent an investment of about $21.5 million in cash and assumed debt.
The proposed purchase, scheduled to close before March 31, 1997, requires completion of a due diligence review.

Alternative Living operates 78 assisted living residences with a total capacity of 3,235 residents. It is currently developing four residences in upstate New York which are free-standing residences purposely designed to serve individuals with memory impairment.

The acquisition of these three properties continues the company's strategy to cluster residences in key market areas, it said. When stabilized, these seven upstate New York residences will add about $18 million to the company's annual revenue in this new market, the company said in a statement.
